title: Penthouse Magazine May 1972 Vintage Sterling Tucker Isaac Asimov
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, May 1972 issue. Featured: "My Secret Visit to the I.R.A." by Col. Corson, an interview with Black leader Sterling Tucker, Isaac Asimov on the mystery of memory, Albert Ellis on sex and guilt, Henry Morgan on ethnic jokes, and "Lesbianism Today: A Frank Study."
Complete issue, no missing pages. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
